biggest_catch: The fee is $0 in year one, so the net math is friendly: up to 80,000 SkyMiles (worth roughly $960 at ~1.2 cents each) plus a $250 statement credit = ~$1,210 in value with $0 fee in year one — but the $150 fee kicks in from year two, and your miles offer may be less than the 80,000 max. And this two-part offer ends 11/4/2026.
catches: Only claim this bonus if you were ALREADY going to spend $3,000 in six months — never spend extra to chase a bonus.
The annual fee is $0 intro for the first year, then $150 — the year-one net is the full ~$1,210, but re-do the math before year two.
The miles portion is 'as high as' 80,000 — Amex tells you your exact amount during the application and it may be lower.
This two-part offer (miles + $250 credit) is limited-time: offer ends 11/4/2026.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry.

Once-per-lifetime rule: no welcome offer if you have or have had this Card, the Delta SkyMiles Options card, or previous versions; Amex may also deny based on balance-transfer history, Card Member history, and cards opened/closed — you are notified before processing so you can withdraw.
Carrying a balance at ~20%+ APR wipes out the bonus instantly — pay in full.

Fees, interest, cash advances, gift cards, prepaid reloads, and person-to-person payments don't count toward the $3,000 threshold; account must not be cancelled or past due at fulfillment; Additional Card Members don't get their own offer.
